name: Noota
description:
Noota records, transcribes and summarises meetings, video calls and phone calls. This connector gives Claude read-only access to that archive, so you can ask questions across everything your team has recorded instead of reopening meetings one by one.

What you can do with it:

- Find meetings by title, date, duration, recording type, participant, folder or workspace
- Search inside transcripts and summaries for a phrase, a topic or a commitment that was made
- Read the verbatim transcript of a specific meeting, filtered by speaker, time range or text
- Look up a contact by name, email or company and pull the conversations you have had with them
- Browse the folders and workspaces your team has organised

Typical uses: preparing for a call by reviewing what was said last time; collecting every objection a prospect raised across a sales cycle; drafting an interview report from a screening call; checking what was actually agreed in a client meeting; summarising a month of team conversations for a report.

All tools are read-only. The connector never creates, edits or deletes anything in Noota, and it returns only the records the signed-in user can already access in their own account.

Requirements: a Noota account on any plan. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 — you sign in with your Noota credentials and approve access, with no API key to copy or store.

Noota stores and processes all data on European infrastructure, and customer conversations are never used to train models.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Noota to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Noota to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.noota.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Noota MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Noota provides these MCP tools: get_transcript, keyword_search, list_folders, list_workspaces, search_contacts, and search_records.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Noota?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Noota in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Noota requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Noota is developed by Noota. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
